cases.name: class example
sequence example
cases.code:
sequenceDiagram
    actor U as User
    participant W as Web app
    participant A as API
    participant D@{ "type": "database" } as Database
    U->>W: Click login
    W->>+A: POST /login
    A->>D: Find user
    alt valid password
        D-->>A: user
        A-->>W: token
    else wrong password
        A-->>W: 401
    end
    deactivate A
    W-->>U: Show result

cases.name: er example
state example
cases.code:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Draft
    Draft --> Review : submit
    Review --> Draft : changes requested
    Review --> Published : approve
    state Published {
        [*] --> Live
        Live --> Archived : expire
    }
    Published --> [*]
